from cache import make_key


def test_cache_key_uniqueness():
    assert make_key("a", 1, 1) == ("a", 1, 1)
    assert make_key("a", 1, 2) != make_key("a", 1, 1)
    assert make_key("a", 2, 1) != make_key("a", 1, 1)
    assert make_key(None, 1, 1) != make_key("a", 1, 1)
    assert make_key("a", None, 1) != make_key("a", 1, 1)
    assert make_key("a", 1, None) != make_key("a", 1, 1)


def test_cache_reuse_and_recompute():
    store = {}
    calls = {"n": 0}

    def compute():
        calls["n"] += 1
        return calls["n"]

    def run(job_text, profile_version, criteria_version):
        key = make_key(job_text, profile_version, criteria_version)
        if key not in store:
            store[key] = compute()
        return store[key]

    assert run("a", 1, 1) == 1
    assert run("a", 1, 1) == 1
    assert calls["n"] == 1
    assert run("a", 1, 2) == 2
    assert run("b", 1, 1) == 3
    assert run(None, None, None) == 4
    assert run(None, None, None) == 4
    assert calls["n"] == 4


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_cache_key_uniqueness()
    test_cache_reuse_and_recompute()
    print("smoke passed")
